Package com.example.ecolums

Class Challenge

java.lang.Object
com.example.ecolums.Challenge
public class Challenge extends Object
Represents a green competition or challenge that students and clubs can participate in to earn points and badges.

Stored in the Firestore collection challenges. Challenges are created by club leaders or admins via AdminDashboard. Individual user scores are aggregated through ProgressTracker and displayed on the per-challenge leaderboard managed by Leaderboard.

Outstanding issues: Per-capita averaging logic for inter-team fairness is not yet implemented.

    • Challenge

      public Challenge(String challengeId, String title, String description, String creatorId, String goalType, double targetValue, String targetUnit, com.google.firebase.Timestamp startDate, com.google.firebase.Timestamp endDate, List<Integer> notificationMilestones)
      Creates a new Challenge.
      Parameters:
      challengeId - Firestore document ID.
      title - Display title.
      description - Short description for the gallery.
      creatorId - UID or club ID of the creator.
      goalType - One of the GOAL_TYPE_* constants.
      targetValue - Numeric target.
      targetUnit - Unit for the target.
      startDate - When the challenge begins.
      endDate - When the challenge ends.
      notificationMilestones - Percentage thresholds for notifications.
